messages:
elaine: Quick design sync 3: thinking about collapsing tool-call results into a right-side 'Inspector' flyout vs inline lanes in Run History. Flyout keeps list compact but loses quick glance of multiple tool results. Putting mock links in figma. Opinions? priyam: Both have merit. Flyout great for deep inspection & keyboard modal flow. Inline lanes better for scannability when you want to compare outputs across calls. Maybe hybrid: inline collapsed summary + "Inspect" opens flyout for deep drill. josh: Hybrid sounds practical. One UX ask: collapsed summary must be explicit: use "Result:" not "Output". Example collapsed line: "Result: 3 items partial" or "Result: error (401)". Keep under 28 chars for translations. meera: Accessibility points: Inspect flyout should be a focus-trap with role="dialog" and aria-labelledby; inline lanes must use role="region" + aria-labelledby. Collapse toggle must be a native button with aria-expanded. For streaming, set aria-live="polite" but only announce finalization to avoid noise. elaine: Good. Copy debate: header formatting options: 1) "fetchCart() 150ms" 2) "fetchCart() Result" 3) "fetchCart() (structured)". Which is clearest? priyam: #1 is useful for perf context. Add a tiny type pill [Structured] next to it. Keep pill color contrast high. josh: Small keyboard UX: left/right to move between run items, Enter to open Inspector, Tab to cycle actions in header (Copy/Schema/Download). In flyout, Up/Down navigate tree nodes. Add visible focus ring and big hit targets for touch. meera: For streaming inside flyout: append visually but keep fragments aria-hidden. On final chunk remove aria-hidden and announce "Tool result complete for fetchCart" via a single polite live-region. If user focus is inside the flyout, do not auto-scroll. Show a small "Jump to latest" control. elaine: Nice. Also thinking about copy actions: header Copy JSON, Download JSON, and Copy path when drilling. Must announce via role=status: "JSON copied" and show a transient tooltip. Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C for copy, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D for download. Thoughts? priyam: Include tooltip + SR announcement. Make shortcut discoverable in the action's tooltip. Ensure to provide fallback in context menu for touch users. josh: Internationalization nit: avoid parentheses and punctuation in short header strings where possible; test length in German/Japanese. I'll add truncation rules. meera: Performance: lazy-render deep nodes; render only visible tree branch. For arrays, show first 3 items with "Show more" button. Ensure screen readers can expand via keyboard. elaine: Implementation snippet I'll attach in Figma notes: ```html
fetchCart() 150ms
``` priyam: :thumbsup: For the flyout role=dialog is correct; ensure focus returns to originating header button on close. Also announce when inspector opens: "Inspector opened for fetchCart" with role=status. josh: Add accessibility test cases: focus trap, aria-expanded toggles, live-region only finalization, copy status toast, and autoscroll pause when user interacted. design-bot: Action items auto-generated: 1) elaine -> update Figma with hybrid mock + ARIA notes, 2) josh -> keyboard + a11y e2e tests, 3) priyam -> header copy variations + i18n length checks, 4) meera -> SR session to validate live-region behavior. Reply here when done. accessibility-bot: Checklist: native button with aria-expanded, role=region/role=dialog as appropriate, aria-live polite only for finalization, fragments aria-hidden during stream, focus management on open/close, copy/download announcements via role=status.
